semantic_fragments.content: IEC 60601-1-2:2014+A1:2020 Clause 5.2.2.3: Requirements applicable to ME equipment that intentionally receive RF electromagnetic energy include the following information: each frequency or frequency of reception, the preferred frequency or frequency band if applicable, and the bandwidth of the receiving section of the ME Equipment in those bands. Result: N/A - Equipment does not intentionally receive RF electromagnetic energy.

IEC 60601-1-2:2014+A1:2020 Clause 5.2.2.4: Requirements applicable to ME equipment that include RF transmitters - technical description includes the frequency or frequency band of transmission, the type and frequency characteristics of the modulation and the effective radiated power (ERP). Result: N/A - EUT does not include RF emission.

IEC 60601-1-2:2014+A1:2020 Clause 5.2.2.5: Requirements applicable to Permanently Installed Large ME equipment and large ME systems - items (a), (b), (c) all marked N/A as the EUT (PT9L) is not a permanently installed large ME system. Items include: exemption statement for radiated RF immunity not tested over 80 MHz to 6 GHz; WARNING about testing only at selected frequencies; list of frequencies and modulations used for immunity testing.

IEC 60601-1-2:2014+A1:2020 Clause 5.2.2.6: Requirements applicable to ME equipment that claim compatibility with HF Surgical equipment - technical description includes a statement of HF Surgical Equipment compatibility and the conditions of intended use during HF Surgery. Result: N/A - The EUT does not claim compatibility with HF Surgical equipment.

Test photographs section (Section 8) documents the following test setups for PT9L EMC testing: 8.1 Radiated Emission Test Setup (Mode 1 and Mode 2); 8.2 ESD Test Setup (Discharge position, Mode 1 and Mode 2); 8.3 Radiated Immunity Test Setup (Mode 1 and Mode 2); 8.4 Proximity Fields from RF Wireless Communications Equipment Test Setup (Battery Power 385MHz~1970MHz; Battery Power 2450MHz~5785MHz); 8.5 EUT photographs.
